B1_discrete_C1_vs_resolvent.claim: Discrete 2-stage contact-limited closed form C1 equals exact matrix-resolvent 2nd-order perturbation

B2_continuous_Floquet_and_C2.claim: Analytical 2x2 Floquet solver matches Padé expm, d=0 gives D=0, uniform washout shifts by -omega_bar, and telegraph matches C2

B3_proposition_B_and_dt_scaling.claim: Proposition B bound has 0 violations across 100 fluctuating-staying schedules and O(dt) staying term halves within 2%

B4_ranks_and_freedman_lane.claim: Midrank Spearman, closed-form partial rank correlation, and exact 6! Freedman-Lane symmetry hold to < 1e-13
